title: Pack Gateway
description: A mod that allows the client to advertise a specific modpack version.
body:
A lightweight client-side utility mod for NeoForge that handles advertising modpack version and verification.

When connecting to a server running PackGateway, this mod automatically reports your modpack version to the proxy during login. If your version is up to date, you connect normally. If your version is outdated, you'll see a disconnect screen with clickable buttons to download the latest modpack and join the community Discord.

Features: Automatic modpack version reporting to the server proxy during login Enhanced disconnect screen with clickable Download and Discord buttons when your pack is outdated. Button labels/URLs are fully configurable via config/packgateway-client.properties.
